question: What sacred, vehicular, and lifeless aspects are simultaneously attributed to the deity?
premises: The deity is the god of holy fords
The deity is the great chariot
inference: The deity unites sacred passage, conveyance, and transcendence of ordinary life.
plain_english: Obeisance to the god of holy fords; obeisance to the great chariot; obeisance to the lifeless one.
